ProblemsWeSolve.title: Problems we solve
ProblemsWeSolve.block1:
Due to the full-scale war, many shelters were forced to evacuate from Donetsk region, losing their territories, infrastructure and enclosures.

They are starting from scratch in new locations and urgently need to restore basic conditions (quality enclosures), feed, and veterinary care.

The number of animals in such shelters is constantly growing due to the continuous evacuation of animals.
ProblemsWeSolve.block2:
Due to overcrowded shelters, many animals cannot be evacuated from the frontline areas of Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv and Donetsk directions, and volunteers work in a constant shortage of resources.

We take on those critical requests that other foundations cannot cover: feed, vaccination and sterilization.

segments.text: was founded on 31.10.2023 by the Nikonchuk family: Oleh and Yevheniia. The foundation helps homeless animals affected by the war and those in frontline areas using the family’s own funds. Due to the constant danger, ensuring their survival is an extremely difficult task. Animals are often left alone with the war, suffering from hunger, cold, disease, and human aggression. The foundation’s mission is to provide animals with medicine, food, vaccinations, sterilization, and most importantly — a chance for rescue and hope for a dignified life.

is to break through people’s indifference and irresponsibility towards animals. People must stop treating animals as objects. This is what humanity truly means. An animal’s life should be valuable to a human! An animal deserves love and safety just as much as a human does!

CharityEvents.title: Our Charity Events
CharityEvents.missionText: All our charity events are held with the support of the Obolon District State Administration in Kyiv and the Obolon Department of Culture.
CharityEvents.missionTitleMob: We have held 7 events that are changing the lives of animals from the frontline.
CharityEvents.missionTitleDesk: We have held 7 events that are changing the lives of animals from the frontline.
paragraphs: Our charity events are family events for people and dogs. All activities and zones are designed to make participation interesting for dogs, children and adults.

Imagine that we are taking you back to a carefree childhood for a few hours. Our charity events are a warm, family atmosphere where you can get away from urgent worries, feel like a child again and, together with your family and four-legged friends, immerse yourself in sincere children's emotions and become a little happier.

The first charity event of the foundation took place on August 20, 2024. It is thanks to such events that we manage to close relevant meetings, help animals in need and form a strong, responsible and caring community of people.

list.title: Themed Photo Zones and Animators
list.text:
We create atmospheric photo zones in Halloween, Christmas, Alice in Wonderland and other themes.
For guests with dogs we always have themed costumes.
Animators from Myata event agency add real holiday spirit to the event, and a professional photographer captures the best moments.

list.title: No-Lose Lottery
list.text: For a donation each participant is guaranteed to receive gifts for their tails from our partners.

list.title: Grooming from the V.O.G DOG salon chain
list.text: A team of female groomers dye the tails' fur, apply glitter tattoos, glue on rhinestones, braid and extend pigtails, trim claws, comb hair, and much more.

list.title: Paw and Hand Prints
list.text: For a donation guests and dogs leave prints with safe paints on canvases.

list.title: Tea Table
list.text: For a voluntary donation guests can enjoy drinks and treats from our partners. We even have vegan sugar-free desserts.

benefits.title: Benefits of Our Charity Initiatives
benefits.subtitle: Together we can do more! Join our events and become part of the big kind family ‘Tail Angels’!
list: Genuine emotions and trust – we create a joyful atmosphere where guests get to know the foundation and see our work.
Educational social mission – at our events, we talk about the problem of stray animals, involving experts to spread a culture of responsible care.
Balance of fun and help – gifts, contests, and lotteries make the events fun and motivate people to help those in need.
Bringing together caring people – people return, become volunteers and friends of the foundation, strengthening our community.
Promoting partners – we collaborate with pet product manufacturers, give away prizes, and help brands connect with audiences through good deeds.
Official support – our events are supported by the Obolon District Administration, and we aim to expand them to other districts of Kyiv.
